mapper.sql: SELECT 'VACATION' AS DOC_TYPE, NO, WRITER_NO, FIRST_APPLY_NO, MID_APPLY_NO, LAST_APPLY_NO, FIRST_STATUS, MID_STATUS, LAST_STATUS, CATEGORY_NO, VACATION_NO, START_TIME, FINISH_TIME, CONTENT, WRITE_DATE, DOCUMENT_DATE, REJECTION, DEL_YN FROM VACATION_FORM UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSINESS' AS DOC_TYPE, NO, WRITER_NO, FIRST_APPLY_NO, MID_APPLY_NO, LAST_APPLY_NO, FIRST_STATUS, MID_STATUS, LAST_STATUS, CATEGORY_NO, NULL AS VACATION_NO, START_TIME, FINISH_TIME, CONTENT, WRITE_DATE, DOCUMENT_DATE, REJECTION, DEL_YN FROM BUSINESS_TRIP_FORM

A.DOC_TYPE , A.NO , A.WRITER_NO , W.NAME AS WRITER_NAME , WD.NAME AS WRITER_DEPART_NAME , WP.NAME AS WRITER_POSITION_NAME , A.FIRST_APPLY_NO , F.NAME AS FIRST_APPLY_NAME , A.FIRST_STATUS , A.MID_APPLY_NO , M.NAME AS MID_APPLY_NAME , A.MID_STATUS , A.LAST_APPLY_NO , L.NAME AS LAST_APPLY_NAME , A.LAST_STATUS , A.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY , A.VACATION_NO , TO_CHAR(A.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_TIME , TO_CHAR(A.FINISH_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FINISH_TIME , A.CONTENT , TO_CHAR(A.WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRITE_DATE , TO_CHAR(A.DOCUMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DOCUMENT_DATE , A.REJECTION

JOIN MEMBER W ON W.NO = A.WRITER_NO LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT WD ON WD.NO = W.DEPART_NO LEFT JOIN POSITION WP ON WP.NO = W.POSITION_NO LEFT JOIN MEMBER F ON F.NO = A.FIRST_APPLY_NO LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.NO = A.MID_APPLY_NO LEFT JOIN MEMBER L ON L.NO = A.LAST_APPLY_NO LEFT JOIN DOCUMENT_CATEGORY C ON C.NO = A.CATEGORY_NO

A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.CATEGORY_NO = 1 AND ( (A.FIRST_APPLY_NO = #{memberNo} AND A.FIRST_STATUS = 1) OR (A.MID_APPLY_NO = #{memberNo} AND A.MID_STATUS = 1) OR (A.LAST_APPLY_NO = #{memberNo} AND A.LAST_STATUS = 1) )
mapper.select: SELECT M.NO , M.NAME , M.AUTH_NO , M.COMPANY_NO , D.NAME AS DEPART_NAME , P.NAME AS POSITION_NAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.NO = M.DEPART_NO LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.NO = M.POSITION_NO WHERE M.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo} AND M.AUTH_NO != 3 AND M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND M.NO != #{memberNo} ORDER BY M.DEPART_NO, M.POSITION_NO DESC, M.NAME
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.WRITER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT A.CATEGORY_NO AS "categoryNo", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM () A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.WRITER_NO = #{memberNo} GROUP BY A.CATEGORY_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE ${type.table} SET FIRST_STATUS = CASE WHEN FIRST_APPLY_NO = #{memberNo} AND FIRST_STATUS = 1 THEN #{status} ELSE FIRST_STATUS END , MID_STATUS = CASE WHEN MID_APPLY_NO = #{memberNo} AND MID_STATUS = 1 THEN #{status} ELSE MID_STATUS END , LAST_STATUS = CASE WHEN LAST_APPLY_NO = #{memberNo} AND LAST_STATUS = 1 THEN #{status} ELSE LAST_STATUS END WHERE NO = #{no} AND CATEGORY_NO = 1 AND DEL_YN = 'N'
